name: xuper-native
description: Xuper TV Standalone Desktop (.exe) & Android (.apk) App without remote backend

scripts.build:web: node scripts/build-android-runtime.mjs && npm --prefix xuper-web run build
scripts.build:apk: powershell -NoProfile -Command "cd xuper-rn/android; ./gradlew.bat --init-script mirror-init.gradle :app:assembleRelease --no-daemon; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; cd ../..; mkdir -Force dist-apk | Out-Null; copy -Force xuper-rn/android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk dist-apk/XuperTV.apk"
